changelog:
## 0.2.2

Fixes from the first online playtest.

- Your partner's outfit now shows in your game. Clothes they wear that you don't were invisible before.
- The joiner can finish enemies off. Before, enemies stopped at 1 health on the joiner's screen.
- No more invisible noise beside the host during fights.
- Enemies on the joiner's screen no longer jump about when they start moving.
- More enemies show on the joiner's screen at once in big fights.
- Enemies that turn up for the joiner (an ambush or reinforcements) no longer go missing in the host's game, and they
  join the fight instead of standing still.

## 0.2.1

Enemies now fight both of you, the way they do in JediCoop for Fallen Order.

- Enemies split between you and take turns. They come after whoever is hitting them, but never switch in the middle of a
  combo.
- Your partner's enemies are real in your game too: their swings hit you, so you can block, parry and dodge them, and a
  parry staggers the enemy for both of you.
- Hit an enemy that's busy with your partner and it may block you, then turn on you.
- Enemy blaster shots fly in both games and hurt whoever they hit. Block and deflect them as usual.
- Enemy footsteps, swings and blaster fire, and their flashes and trails, show and sound on both screens.
- Enemies that turn up during a fight (an ambush or reinforcements) appear for both of you.
- Enemies hold their blasters in their hands on the joiner's screen.
- The partner tile shows how far away your partner is beside their name.

## 0.2.0

The first co-op build for testers: play Jedi: Survivor together online. Early and rough: expect bugs, and tell us.

- Host a co-op journey from the title screen (ONLINE CO-OP), from one of your saves or a new game. Your friend joins
  with your code and plays your journey with you.
- See your partner in your game: their Cal, lightsaber, blaster and BD-1, with their name above them.
- See and hear what they do: their swings, footsteps and effort sounds, their saber ignition and BD-1's effects, and the
  sparks when they block, parry or deflect.
- No pausing in co-op: opening the menu or the map keeps the world going. Your partner's name shows IN THE MENU,
  MEDITATING, ON THE MAP or DOWN.
- When your partner fast travels, you're offered to follow them. When they fly to another planet, you're asked to board
  your Mantis and fly there from its holotable. At a meditation point you can go to the one nearest them, and after a
  death far from them you're offered to go back.
- Enemies: damage and kills are shared, and the enemies your friend sees move as they do in the host's game.
- Doors your partner opens open in your game too (doors they push or pull open with the Force as well), and automatic
  doors slide open as your partner walks up to them.
- ENEMY HEALTH in the lobby: how tough enemies are for co-op (Normal, Tougher, Toughest). New co-op journeys start on
  Tougher; the host can change it before beginning.
- UNLOCKS in a new journey's lobby: YOUR OWN (each of you keeps what you find) or SHARED (what one of you takes is
  taken in both games, and you both get it).
- Stuck? Open the pause menu and press U (or View on a controller) twice.
- The co-op chip shows your partner's name, with their planet and how far away they are, or what they're doing.
- Following your partner: while the screen is black, the place you're going to and who you're following show at the
  top left, and the game's own place card takes over when you arrive. Places use the game's own names.
- Pop-ups are smaller and don't pile up during a trip, and questions show the game's own key icons for keyboard or
  controller.
- Closing the game tells your partner straight away.
- Your Discord profile shows when you're hosting, joining or playing together.
- The lobby shows which region's relay connects you when you aren't connected directly.
- Offensive player names show as "Player".
- The first time your friend joins they play your Cal; from their next session on they play their own Cal, with their
  outfit, skills and finds. Cutscenes play for each of you on your own for now.

## 0.1.0

- The first early access build for testers. It doesn't add co-op yet: it checks Jedi: Survivor runs with JediCoop.
- Your Discord profile shows you're playing Jedi: Survivor as an early access tester.
- Turn that off in JediCoop.ini ([Discord] Presence=0) if you'd rather it didn't.
